notes.title: Arachnophobia update - The second most annoying enemy in video games
notes.notes:
One of the most annoying thing in video games right after invisible enemies? Spiders. In all shapes and sizes. Harmless in small numbers, lethal if you get surrounded.

And that's why we added hordes of these eight legged, egg-spawning, savage little f***ers to keep you occupied. Destroy nests and eggs before they hatch!

Also huge load of bugs fixed and features added. For example loading screens, blood splashes to HUD when taking dmg, modified shaders to make the levels, weather & gore to look even more realistic etc.

(Invisible demons coming up on next update, n00bs.)
